plugin.name: Daily Catgirl Care
plugin.description: Morning fish-slacking report, daily fortune slip, and water reminders combined in one plugin, each with its own switch. Fortune is generated deterministically by date (same day, same result); the report includes the weekday, weekend countdown, and payday countdown; water reminders fire at your configured interval during working hours. All copy is in the catgirl's voice, and proactive pushes go through push_message.
